subject: Azure co-sell pricing carveout request — Novatek strategic pilot
messages:
From: Chris Liu <chris.liu@novatek.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Novatek pilot — pricing flexibility and marketplace listing

Alex —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Novatek is excited about the Redwood runtime performance, and SDG (their internal AI team) wants to run a 6-month pilot across two lines of business. Procurement asked me to check whether we can get a Marketplace-friendly pricing carveout for this pilot so the deal can flow through AWS co-sell and be listed in their marketplace catalog.

They specifically asked for:
- 30% off list for the first 6 months (pilot)
- Private Offer via AWS Marketplace with a single consolidated PO
- Ability to convert to standard list pricing post-pilot with a 60-day notice

Attached is a short SOW and their draft commercial sheet. Can you advise next steps and whether Redwood can support this pricing path?

Thanks,
Chris
Chris Liu
Director, Strategic Programs
Novatek Systems

--
Novatek_Pilot_SOW_v0.3.pdf (attached)
Novatek_AWS_Commercials.xlsx (attached)
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Chris Liu <chris.liu@novatek.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novatek pilot — pricing flexibility and marketplace listing

Chris —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the materials. High level: we can support a Private Offer on AWS Marketplace with a time-bound pilot discount, but it needs Deal Desk approval and Marketplace packaging by our listing team. I looped Vanessa (Marketplace) to start the listing checklist and Ben (Deal Desk) to validate concession guardrails.

If helpful, here are the key items we'll need from Novatek to move fast:
1) Confirmed pilot scope + seats (prod vs sandbox)
2) Expected monthly committed spend (rough $USD)
3) Any regulatory/compliance constraints (data residency, logging)
4) Legal point of contact for PO and SOW signoff

Proposed next steps: Vanessa to open the AWS Private Offer intake, Ben to review discount justification and escalation path. I'll coordinate timelines. Can Novatek confirm items 1–2 by EOD Wednesday?

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 11:35:00 -0800
Subject: AWS Private Offer intake — Novatek (RNW-2027-0689)

Alex / Ben —

I've started the Marketplace intake. Quick notes:
- Private Offer is supported; we'll need a catalog SKU (we can reuse the 'dedicated-pilot-1' SKU) and a published contract slab for the pilot period.
- AWS requires a minimum 6-month term on some Private Offers to qualify for certain co-sell incentives; we should confirm with Dana at the Partner team.
- Proposed timeline: intake -> AWS packaging (5 business days) -> internal pricing approval -> publish.

Ben, can you review the requested 30% concession? From a marketplace perspective this looks aggressive versus standard co-sell guidance. Provided details from Novatek and a short ROI justification would help. I've attached a short intake summary with estimated ARR math.

Attachments: HubSpot-RNW-2027-0689-summary.txt

-Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Programs Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 08:46:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer intake — Novatek (RNW-2027-0689)

Team —

I pulled the initial ask: 30% off list for six months, then revert to list. Questions/concerns from Deal Desk perspective:
- Concession size: 30% for a new account pilot is outside our standard pilot band (we normally approve up to 15% for first-time pilots without exec sign-off).
- Marketplace dynamics: deep short-term discounts can set bad precedent for future listing pricing and co-sell comps. We need a clear upsell/convert plan and committed minimum ARR post-pilot to justify.
- Financials: need expected monthly committed spend, and an LTV estimate if conversion happens.

Please provide the following as soon as possible so I can decide if this can be handled at Deal Desk level or requires VP approval:
1) Novatek confirmed committed monthly spend for pilot (USD)
2) Target conversion ARR percentage (expected percent of pilot spend converting to paid)
3) Executive sponsor at Novatek confirming they will consider a conversion purchase if pilot KPIs are met
4) Any marketplace co-sell references or similar concessions we've done in the last 12 months (Marissa can pull examples)

If we cannot get those within 24–48 hours, I'll escalate to VP for ad-hoc approval.

-Ben
Ben Carter
Sr. Revenue Operations — Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Chris Liu <chris.liu@novatek.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@novatek.com, Dana Park <dana.park@aws-partner.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 13:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Novatek pilot — pricing flexibility and marketplace listing

Alex / Vanessa / Ben —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Answers below: 
1) Committed monthly spend: $60,000 USD (estimated)
2) Target conversion: we expect ~50% of pilot spend to convert within 3 months after pilot if KPIs met; Novatek has a roadmap to expand if initial tests pass.
3) Executive sponsor: Sarah McKay (Head of Product & Strategy) — she is copied on procurement and will sign the PO.
4) I can share a reference from a comparable marketplace pilot; attaching the SOW + commercials (same as earlier).

We recognize Redwood needs guardrails so happy to include a one-time conversion bonus or step-down pricing to avoid long-term list erosion. Our legal team prefers the Private Offer route and a single PO.

Chris
Chris Liu
Director, Strategic Programs
Novatek Systems

--
Attachments: Novatek_Pilot_SOW_v0.3.pdf, Novatek_AWS_Commercials.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Nov 2027 16:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: AWS Private Offer intake — Novatek (RNW-2027-0689) — Decision

Team —

I've reviewed the numbers and comparable recent Marketplace concessions. Given Novatek's $60k/month committed spend and a plausible 50% conversion signal, I am prepared to approve a conditional carveout under these constraints: 
- Approve 25% discount on list for a 6-month pilot (reduced from requested 30%)
- Private Offer via AWS Marketplace with explicit clause: discount expires at pilot end; conversion pricing to be negotiated but must be >= 85% of list for first 12 months post-conversion
- Require Novatek to sign an MOU confirming conversion intent and list of KPIs (productivity, latency, API traffic thresholds) before publishing
- Redwood to add a one-time conversion uplift credit (10% credit against first three months post-conversion if Novatek converts within 60 days)

I think this balances the need to win the pilot while protecting listing comps. Ben: you can document this as an approved concession (Deal Desk ticket #DD-2027-1157). Vanessa: initiate AWS packaging and ask Dana to confirm any co-sell incentive implications. Alex: please secure the MOU and exec confirmation from Sarah McKay.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
